book.name: Matthew Iesu da bino dave Matthew mi gagurisina.

book.title: Matthew Iesu da bino dave Matthew mi gagurisina.

content: Iesu mi embo ave awa bajinabé bajina utuda gisijiari yai atopaposisina.
Edo iji ainde ambodanimi Iesu da yai gundo ainde sitera, “Embo ave awa bajinabé bajina utuda gisijiari yai
ri?”
Ango tetero Iesu mai saka dao tesiri ainda yai gumbiri awamaneda toropuda pipisisina.
Edo embo ami sisina, “Eiwa gebé imondemane tena, imomane do itomane awa kundo wareregedo dá mai babaingae ango awa, utuda gisijiari yai torawa. Ata edo ango ainyae gido awa, mana torawa.
Awatedo embo ain tataimbedo mai saka engo aina awa, imo awa embo bajinabé bajina utuda gisijiari yai.
Edo embo dá ainmi mai saka da (1) engo awa dao natoda ategeteite bureira awa, ami na ategeteite bureira.
Iesu mi embo da ainmi embo nei bawari jimboda dururekae sisina.
“Embo ainmi ari eiwamane babaingae engo da (1) gebé ari nato yai awa dowaina gido, dave awa ainda duboda ganuma bajina kaingedo ewa ugonuda augaro un injido betaina.
Do ari tena embo berari butuda awa, aindabé rorae neide kaindemi ari embo jimboda durudo ara awaembo! Bawari angogoda edo gumbara, ata do ari embo ainmi embo nei bawari jimboda duraina!

“Edo ito ipa o taimi jigamo edo imo jimbo beyae ata ango gido awa, kautugedo awa augeyo. Davebé awa ine wasiri natopo itarida tai da (1) itae o ipa da (1) itae torata, gaegae edo imo jimbo beyae ipa tote (2)de tai tote (2)demi ata awa, imo niyao natopo itarida ainda augara.

Edo ito jisimi rorae ro gido imo jimbo beyae ata ango gido, jisi awa gurugedo awa augeyo. Awa beyae ae imo inono jisi da (1)de wasiri natopo itarida torata, gaegae edo jisi tote (2)mi gido jimbo beyae ata awa, imo kundo yai beyae niyao matawa aveira ainda augara.
Iesu eniya ge wo sipu dadoegarida budo embomai atopaposisina.
“Aindabé Embo da Mai embomai dadoegari awa toregaintedo guputena,

eiwa dave edo giwo! Nane imondemane tena, eiwamane babaingaeda anelamane utuda awa iji berari Mamo nato utuda dombuda isite awamane embo God da yai benunu tain era. Awatedo eiwamane babaingae jisi tuda edo giwove!

Edo imomane nongo kotembetevi? Embo da (1)mi ainda wo sipumane ajigari 100 sima edo esira, edo ainda sipu da (1)mi idegedo dadoegesira. Embo awa ainda sipumane 99 awa peji pamoda dodo aundo sipu da (1) dadoegesira awa kakowa ainita? Gebé, ainda sipu da (1) kakowa aina.
Edo embo ami tamaina, eiwa gebé imondemane tena, embo ainda yawa ari wo sipu dadoegesiri tambirada yai amimi ainda yawa ari wo sipumane 99 dadoegaeda yai awa daginegaina.
Edo dá ango Mamo itomane utuda, ainda jipapa awa eiwamane babaingaeda da (1) dadoegeure.
Edo ito nameji jimbo beyae ito yaida ari gido, kondade ari ge teyo do wareregare.
“Edo ito namejimi ito yaida jimbo ari gido, aundo embo ainde akuta dada edo ine ainda jimbo beyae awa teyo gare. Edo embo ami ito ge awa ingaina awa, imo ito nameji awa tekago bata.

Ata ge awa tato ingae aina gido awa, embo da (1) ta tote (2) budo ainda yai maundo God da Ge gaiarida engo tari awa ambo ambo eyo, ‘embo tote (2) ta tamonde (3)mi itomane mina tara arida ge udugedo gorote, jimbo beyae emboda katae gisida.’

Edo embo awa awamaneda ge ingainyae ari gido awa, nato embomaida doregaride teyo gore. Ata edo embo awa daedo nato embomaida doregarida ge ingainyae ari gido awa, embo awa etene embo ango edo tax kumbari embo ango arate ito yai.
“Eiwa gebé imondemane tena, rorae ro inemane butu einda bundawa dá ango God matu sisina awa, God mi bundesira. Edo rorae ro inemane butu einda udegawa dá ango God matu sisina awa, God mi udegesira.
“Edo daedo, eiwa gebé imondemane tena, edo imomane tote (2) butu einda ami awara edo kondade ari ro jipapa edo benunu tawa awa, Mamo nato utuda ami imomane embo aina.
Aindabé, edo tote (2) ta tamonde (3)mi nato daoda dada etera awa, na awamaneda toropuda daedo itena.”
Embomaida jimbo bebegae ito yaida kotembedo doyo.
Ango edo Peter gundo ainda yai edo sisina, “Badari, nato nameji iji nandogo nato yai jimbo ari na kotembedo dowani? Visido iji 7 anita?”
Edo Iesu mi embo ainde sisina, “Na imonde visido iji 7 tae, ata iji 70 x 7, ango tena.
“Awatedo utuda gisijiari awa ango
daotari da (1)mi ainda buro emboboda yai ainda kondade ari ganu gisi piesiri buritera awa, tekago ainda yai kundo gumbaro sirigain sisina.

Edo embo ami ganu awa tuturo edo sirigedo awamanemi buro embo da (1) kundo ainda yai guputera. Edo buro embo awa ganu 10,000,000 kina ango awa matu burisina. Awatedo ainda badarimi ganu awa ainda yai tekago piarate sisina.
Ata buro embomi ganu awa piari tao ae awa gido badarimi ge okain sisina, embo awa ae ainda aro de ainda mamai de ainda roviravi berari de awa kundo oriaro ainda ganu inono baina sisina.
“Awatedo buro embo awa ainda doda durudo baongo dadari edo sisina, ‘Tataimbeyo, badari, ganu berari awa ito yai piane!’
Ango edo buro emboda badari awa do memesi budo embo awa udegesisina, edo ainda ganu nandogo jigamo esisini awa kotembedo doturisina.

“Ata buro embo awa idegedo aundo ainda buro otawo nei awa tapusina. Edo ine ainda buro otawode kondade ari ganu 100 silver ango matu piesiri burisina. Awatedo embo awa tamundo ainda duboda kundo sisina, ‘Ganu nato imonde matu pieteno buriteta awa, tekago nato yai pie!’
“Edo ainda buro otawo ainda taida durudo gegata esisina, ‘Tataimbeyo, ganu awa ito yai piane.’
“Ata ainda buro otawoda ge jindedo embo awa kundo bundari oroda augesiri totorisina, isiari jirari ganu inono embo ainde piari ainda udegari awara aina.
Edo ainda buro otatawo neneimi ro idegesiri awa gido dubo vevera bajinabé esitera. Awatedo awamaneda badarida yai maundo ro berari idegesiri awa tetero gosisina.
“Edo ainda badarimi embo awa dao tesiri gumbiri ainde sisina, ‘Imo buro embo beyaebé! Ine nato yai gegata eteta, awatedo imo ganu berari tekago namonde piae awa kotembedo dotena.
Imo ito buro otawo do ae eteta dá nane imo do etena ango, ata ango ae.’
Edo ainda badari sinigambari edo buro embo awa memesi piari emboboda ipada pipisisina, isimango mina inono berari ainda badarida yai piari ainda udegari awara aina.”
Edo Iesu mi ge ao gogumbesite sisina, “Edo imomane dara dara ito namejida jimbo bebegae awa bé kotembedo dowainyae, Mamo nato utuda isira ami dá ango itomane yai aina.”

footnotes.text: utuda gisijiari yai awa God da sima ari daveda yai (Matthew 18:3-4da ge awa dá ango.).
-11 Aindabé Embo da Mai embomai dadoegari awa toregaintedo guputena. Guriki da ove gaiari indewae Matthew 18:11 da ge eiwa piae doturitera.
embo awa etene embo ango edo tax kumbari embo ango arate ito yai da moka awa ‘imo embo ainde umojiainyae’.
utuda gisijiari awa ango da moka awa ‘Nongo edo God mi ainda gisijiarida buro aina awa ango’.
Iji ainde, awamaneda wasiri awa buriya emboda orobemi kondade edo ganu inono imo embo piaro ainda udegari bundari oroda edo barate.
